page.layout: One page of text, with a woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph. Running head at the top, a division heading "CONCIO XXIII", a scripture reference line beneath it, then one paragraph of italic text. No margin notes. Page number at the top right. Signature "L" at the foot.

l.i: Custodi fili mi praeceptum patris
tui, & ne deseras legem matris
tuae. Liga ea super cor tuum
iugiter, & adnecte ea gutturi
tuo. Cum ambulaveris ducet te, & cum
dormieris custodiet te, & cum evigilave-
ris ipsa loquetur tecum. Quia lucerna
est praeceptum, & lex est lumen: atq; via
vitae, correptio & castigatio. Ut custodi-
at te a muliere mala, & a blanditiis lin-
guae extraneae. Non concupiscas pulchri-
tudinem eius in corde tuo, ne capiat te
palpebris suis. Quoniam propter mulie-
rem meretricem (peruenit fornicator)
usque ad massam panis, & mulier vena-
tur preciosam animam viri. Numquid
fouebit aliquis ignem in sinu suo, ut ve-
stimenta sua non comburantur? Aut si
gradietur quis supra carbones ut pedes
eius non aduruntur? Sic qui ingreditur
ad uxorem proximi sui, non innoxius e-
rit, quisquis accesserit ad eam. Non con-
temptui habent furem, quando furatur
ut adimpleat animam suam, esuriens e-
nim facit. Et deprehensus reddit septu-

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated C; joined to the first word as "Custodi". The first word is printed as "Vstodi" beside the woodcut. The page number "161" is partly worn and uncertain. The running head is set in decorative capitals. Proverbs 6:20-22 is printed in the text with the printed spellings, including "adnecte", "deseras" (long s, possibly with an abbreviation mark), and "septu-" at the line end, which continues on the next page. The "L" at the foot is a gathering signature.
